主要内容: This report is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, detailing the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E. The filing includes information about the Notes, such as their names, pricing dates, settlement dates, and principal amounts. The report also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the Notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing is part of the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The report was published on January 19, 2012, and is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement.
